product.name: expand.ai Web Scraping API
product.description: An API that converts any public website into a type-safe, structured data source for developers to extract information reliably and securely.

product.name: Custom Schema Configuration
product.description: A feature allowing users to customize the data schema to fit specific extraction needs from websites.

product.name: Data Quality Assurance
product.description: A system that verifies and traces extracted data back to its source to ensure accuracy and prevent hallucination.

product.name: High-Speed Data Extraction
product.description: Extraction models designed to operate up to ten times faster than comparable AI models for rapid data retrieval.

product.name: Scalable Web Crawling Infrastructure
product.description: Infrastructure that supports scaling web crawling operations to millions of pages with managed proxies and browser automation.
